name: County Line Field Book
title: County Line Field Book
description: A pocket notebook for campsite sketches, turn-offs worth remembering and one line before heading home.
summary: Some turns are worth a second visit. Keep the small details on paper: a creek crossing, a good lunch stop, the name of the road you meant to remember.

rows.label: Cover
rows.value: Kraft-colored softcover with a winding-road illustration

rows.label: Design notes
rows.value: Illustrative specifications, not measurements from a manufactured sample

care: Plain pages leave room for a sketch, a list or a few lines. Add the date and road name before the small details fade; check access rules before sharing a stop with someone else.
Keep the notebook dry and carry it in a pouch when the weather turns. It is not a waterproof notebook or a substitute for a map. Let damp pages air dry open, away from direct heat.
